snippet.title: Los 40 Karaoke Party Vol. 2
snippet.description:
Spain’s number one music channel "Los 40 Principales" is back with its official Karaoke Party Vol. 2 – the only singing game to feature 40 of the GREATEST hits from the super hot Los 40 Music Charts! 

Sing along to this pop hit extravaganza which is exclusively presented by Tony Aguilar & Cristina Boscá!

For more information, please visit the Bandai Namco Official Website http://bit.ly/1KCJlGf
